annotations.text:
Three pixel worlds, same screen. Pick one and I build the other five pages in it.

All three cut the old Overview from 15 competing blocks to five: net worth, four vitals, one decision, one agent log. Wording is plain — 'Free each month', not 'Monthly surplus'.

A — COZY SAVE FILE
Chunky borders, hard offset shadows, warm cream. Pixelify Sans + Figtree.

Friendliest, and best fit for 'refreshes the user'. Risk: cosy can read as unserious for money.

B — TERMINAL QUEST
Dark CRT with scanlines, corner brackets, segmented bars. VT323 + Manrope.

Most obviously a game, and the agent log feels native here. Risk: dark + neon is close to what you already rejected.

C — ARCADE LEDGER
High contrast, 3px black rules, huge blocky numerals, one red accent. Silkscreen + Plus Jakarta Sans.

Sleekest and most legible. Risk: the most restrained — least 'game', most poster.
